newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 12.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - The China Securities Regulatory Commission, the top securities and futures watchdog, has withdrawn the business licence of Jiaxin Futures Co for submitting false financial statements.

- Dai Xianglong, the governor of the People's Bank, the central bank, has said the prosperity of Hong Kong after China's takeover of the British colony will have a decisive impact on the stability of the whole Asian region.
- BUSINESS NEWS - Shanghai international automobile and manufacturing technology exhibition opened on Wednesday with the participation of major world auto makers including General Motors.
